mods.name: Recursive AE2 Pattern Provider
mods.description: Add the functionality to have auto recursive pattern provider in AE2 avoiding adding the child crafting recipes

releases.notes:
Make maxAlternativesPerItem effective and rank stock-driven recipes last

  - Apply maxAlternativesPerItem in both selection modes (a hard-coded 64
    bypassed it when retainRecipeAlternatives=true) and count distinct
    recipes instead of ingredient variants. Default raised from 1 to 8.
  - RecipeSelection.alternatives(): also publish recipes rank() rejected
    only because their ingredients loop back into the recipe graph (tiered
    essences). Order: acyclic recipes, cyclic recipes, stock-driven ones.
  - Treat tier uncrafts (one item in, more of a recipe-reversible item out)
    like block unpacks: ranked last, not counted toward the cap, not
    expanded. The matching compression recipe is published for each unpack.
  - Reorder CraftingService.getCraftingFor so user-encoded patterns come
    first, then generated ones, then generated stock-driven ones; AE2 keeps
    same-priority patterns in a HashSet, so generation order had no effect.
  - Skip generating patterns for items the grid already reports craftable.
  - Static selection publishes one ingredient variant per recipe, so tags
    (glass, wood) no longer multiply patterns.
  - Add debugLogging option (default off) gating the per-item [alternatives]
    diagnostics, plus a single INFO line when the cap leaves recipes out
    and a build marker at load.
  - Add missing config translations (defaultRecursiveMode,
    retainRecipeAlternatives, generatedIngredientAlternatives, debugLogging).

- RecipeSelection.alternatives(): also publish recipes rank() rejected only

- Stock conversions (block <-> items) no longer count toward the cap, and
the matching compression recipe is published for each unpack conversion.
- Reorder CraftingService.getCraftingFor so generated unpack patterns are
tried last; AE2 keeps same-priority patterns in a HashSet, so generation
order had no effect.
- Add missing config translations (defaultRecursiveMode,
retainRecipeAlternatives, generatedIngredientAlternatives).
- Add [alternatives] diagnostic logging and a build marker at load.
